## How it was made

Standard v1 ([docs/PIPELINE.md](../../../docs/PIPELINE.md)): measured to scale, re-rendered straight
and clean from a photo, every printed label checked.
Body aspect 0.2839 (spec 0.2907), screen at the exact 240:320 aspect.

**Credits:** appearance from a [photo](https://i.blogs.es/25f21f/sony-ericsson-t707-10/2560_3000.webp (press render, Xataka Movil gallery; reflection cropped off)); geometry measured on a [photo](https://i.blogs.es/25f21f/sony-ericsson-t707-10/2560_3000.webp); specs: [teltarif.de](https://www.teltarif.de/h/sony-ericsson/t707/).
